newsitem.title: FRANCE: French rail passengers stranded in cold snap.
newsitem.headline: French rail passengers stranded in cold snap.

text.p: Some 5,000 rail passengers were stranded in southern France overnight on Thursday when snow and ice stuck to overhead power lines, blocking about 10 trains including some high-speed TGVs, railway officials said.
The SNCF state railway authority said as many passengers as possible were being put up in lodgings but many others would spend the night on heated trains standing in stations.
Passenger and freight services were blocked between Valance and Avignon and between France's second city, Lyon, and the Mediterranean port of Marseille, the officials said.
The problems were caused by ice on the overhead electric cables used to power the trains, the SNCF said, adding that it hoped to re-establish service on major lines by Friday morning.
A nine-day cold snap has sent temperatures plunging across Europe and is expected to last into the weekend.
